view.get: what the user is looking at (viewport, selection, focus, window visibility, appearance) exists only in a connected Mac client
view.render: drawn by a connected Mac client so it matches what the user sees (docs/design/next.md); output is pixels
view.snapshot: the board's window as the user sees it: needs the client's window
agent.prompt: types into the terminal through the client's live terminal surface (bracketed paste, Return after the paste lands)
agent.read: reads the terminal through the client's terminal tile (zmx scrollback joined by the live surface's soft-wrap flags; `block` from Ghostty prompt marks); easld takes it over together with zmx sessions
object.reload: reloads a browser tile's page in the client's WebKit view, or recomputes a diagram through language servers
